scope: Parse and prove the exact three-file unselected RSP-130 prototype, then format only these paths in a separate tracked source copy using Ruff 0.15.17 alone. Preserve all 4,623 original source leaves, five whole-file source inverses, the exact original inline fallback and surrounding caller AST, complete three-file before/after payloads, strict AST/type-comment/literal/token/comment bridges, patch and original command logs. No project import, pytest body, typing, opcode measurement, timing, native/installed workload or task qualification runs here. A newly immutable formatted source and fresh source bridge must precede the separate 45-case and six-operation-cell validation.

recipe.required: Actual unchanged baseline/candidate ordered node/parameter/marker/fixture equality on all 23 existing cases; actual candidate 22 controls and ordered per-node phase/JUnit reconciliation. No test/body/fixture assertions altered.

preparation_count_correction.reason: The existing transport-failure test has the unchanged two-value failure_kind parameter (http, network).

performance_selection.proposal: After exact source/semantic gates, run at least five alternating independent controlled cohorts of original and proposed join with full raw cells, CPU/wall/allocation observations; fixture creation, opcode tracing and import costs stay outside timed join. Record them separately.
performance_selection.input_matrix: Vary S and P independently, include S=1 and empty/small groups, production-shaped distinct IDs, repeated snapshot IDs, repeated source references, cold freshly allocated equal key values and warm reuse. Never use a shared pre-hashed key population for only the later arm.
performance_selection.whole_route: Then repeat the existing source-bound 24/128/486-file incremental inventory scenarios with actual traversal/upsert behavior and identical controlled scanner/cloud conditions, reporting local CPU and full wall separately. Missing real scanner/cloud routes remain unavailable; no fabricated success.
performance_selection.gate: RSP-012 must declare the applicable original PRD go/no-go boundary before timing. A selected hot-path claim requires the existing >=30% p95 or process-tree CPU benefit and <=5% regression in the other primary metric when that tranche definition applies; this proposal does not silently substitute a microbenchmark for it.
performance_selection.fallback: If benefit is immaterial or small-input/resource regressions fail the predeclared rule, retain the original production join and preserve the rejected experiment.

historical_evidence.scope: Preparation and source-only peer references; no previous runtime or performance result applies to this prototype.
